nodes.title: SG-8.4.1 Rewrite the repo-root context.md to the real stack and modules
nodes.body:
Context: context.md is still the README-only draft, with 'hello Worldseed', a Traceability index, a Bidirectional links section and 13 UNKNOWN placeholders. The docs check helpers (STACK_TERMS, STALE_TEXT, contextModulePaths, missingPaths) and the contextStack, contextDoc and contextPaths tests already exist in game/frontend. Desired behavior: context.md names TypeScript, Phaser 3.90, React, Zustand, Radix, Vitest and Go (backend), and its module table lists only game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/. Expected result: the three context tests pass. Why: the master index must match the code.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the repo-root context.md, when contextStack.test.ts runs, then every STACK_TERMS entry and the word Go are present and no UNKNOWN, 'hello Worldseed' or 'Traceability index' text remains.
- Given the module table, when contextPaths.test.ts and contextDoc.test.ts run, then contextModulePaths returns game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/ and every path exists on disk.


## Scope
- In scope: context.md Stack, Modules and stale sections
- In scope: Docs check helper contracts in game/frontend/src/lib
- Out of scope: backend/ changes
- Out of scope: gameplay changes
- Out of scope: GDD content changes
- Preserve: Existing contextStack, contextDoc, contextPaths and docsCheck tests
- Preserve: Phaser pinned at ~3.90.0


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0
- No test is deleted or skipped
- npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/
- backend/ (Go) is out of scope
- No source file in game/src or game/frontend/src over 200 lines


## Definition of done
- The three context tests pass
- Typecheck passes in game/frontend


## Clarifying questions
- None

- Given context.md, when missingTerms(text, STACK_TERMS) runs, then it returns [] and /\bGo\b/ matches.
